lines.en: My cloak drags across the muddy floor.
A king walks slowly, but never stops.

lines.zh: 这双脚走不稳，王冠很重。
lines.en: My feet are unsteady; the crown is heavy.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，都算国土。
lines.en: Wherever I walk becomes my kingdom.
Where is my escort? Never mind, I walk alone.

lines.zh: 我的靴子沾了太多腐土。
lines.en: My boots are caked with rotten soil.
My subjects should clear my path.
Too many steps; my crown nearly fell.

lines.zh: 我一步一步巡我的废墟。
lines.en: Step by step I tour my own ruins.
Slow or not, these are a king's steps.
I am waiting for subjects to pay homage.

lines.zh: 王座不在了，我站着也行。
lines.en: The throne is gone; standing will do.
I count the echoes in my empty hall.
This crown is worth many gold ingots.

lines.zh: 我的朝堂连个卫兵都没有。
lines.en: Not a single guard remains in my court.
Quiet, the king is thinking.
I stroke my chin and find only bone.
The treasury should be right below here.

lines.zh: 我在这坐了很多年，虽然没椅子。
lines.en: I have sat here years, though without a chair.
The daylight is too bright for my taste.
I smooth the tatters of my old sleeve.
Who is stealing my gold?
I am dead, but the etiquette remains.

lines.zh: 这具身体坐得太多，僵了。
lines.en: This body sat too long and went stiff.

lines.zh: 我清了清嗓子，只咳出灰。
lines.en: I clear my throat and only cough up dust.

lines.zh: 王在数今天收到几个人头。
lines.en: The king is counting today's heads.
You do not kneel before your king?

lines.zh: 你的帽子，比我的差远了。
lines.en: Your hat is nothing beside my crown.
I hereby make you a gatekeeper.

lines.zh: 你身上没有王家的味道。
lines.en: You carry no scent of royalty.
Look up and let your king see your face.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲太旧，配不上朝堂。
lines.en: Your armor is too shabby for my court.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看见一点敬畏。
lines.en: I see a little awe in your eyes.
Do you still recognize my face?
All subjects should look up at me like this.
Is that an offering in your hand?
You stand too close; that is improper.
Your king has noted your appearance.
You dare strike your king? Insolent.
My royal robe has been torn.
It hurts, but a king does not cry out.
For that blade, your whole house is marked.
My crown has slipped to one side.
Even a king's bones are not hard.

lines.zh: 你砍掉了王的半只袖子。
lines.en: You cut away half my royal sleeve.
Not the face; that is the king's face.

lines.zh: 这点伤，配不上我的身份。
lines.en: This wound is beneath my station.
The king will remember this blow.
A king does not eat such things.

lines.zh: 我的御厨早就化成灰了。
lines.en: My royal kitchen turned to dust long ago.

lines.zh: 献上来吧，我不吃，但能赏人。
lines.en: Offer it; I will not eat, but I may grant it.
What is this, pig feed?
This dish is not on the royal menu.
I smell it; it smells of soil.
Your king drinks only powdered gold.
Take it back; do not soil my hands.
Hunger is a commoner's concern.
I grant you the food; now give thanks.
What penalty for striking your king?
Your boot is planted on my royal cloak.
Three steps back; your king passes.

lines.zh: 这具身体撞起来全是骨头。
lines.en: Bumping this body means hitting bone.
My crown is crooked; look at it.

lines.zh: 你赔得起我一根肋骨吗？
lines.en: Can you afford to replace one rib?

lines.zh: 王不与人推挤，太失体面。
lines.en: A king does not shove; it lacks dignity.
Shoulder against shoulder breaks propriety.
You bruised my royal shoulder piece.
Make way; your king is touring.
The queen lies buried in the tomb.

lines.zh: 王室血脉，断在我这里了。
lines.en: The royal line ends with me.
What marriage could a corpse discuss?

lines.zh: 我的婚礼办过，宾客都死了。
lines.en: I held a wedding; the guests are all dead.
You are not fit to join the royal house.

lines.zh: 王不需要伴侣，只需要臣民。
lines.en: A king needs subjects, not a consort.
This crown has no heir.
The marriage contract rotted in the grave.

lines.zh: 别想了，王连脉搏都没有。
lines.en: Forget it; your king has no pulse.

lines.zh: 若要联姻，先拿王国来换。
lines.en: To marry me, bring a kingdom first.
Gold on the ground belongs to the king.

lines.zh: 这块金锭，正好补我的王冠。
lines.en: This ingot will patch my crown.
Who dares snatch from a king's hand?
Bending is hard, but worth it.
Diamonds? Into my treasury with them.
This ring was once mine.
Pick it up and enter it in the ledger.

lines.zh: 臣民掉的东西，自然归王。
lines.en: What a subject drops belongs to the king.
I take it not from greed, but as tax.

lines.zh: 这堆东西够重修一间殿了。
lines.en: This pile could rebuild one whole hall.
You trampled the king's lawn.
Rude wretch, your king has noted you.
Target confirmed; you are summoned to court.
The king will deal with you personally.
You are dressed rather like an assassin.
Do not run; fleeing subjects fare worse.
I sentence you to death, effective now.

lines.zh: 王的视线落到你身上了。
lines.en: The king's gaze has fallen upon you.
You breathe on the king's land.

lines.zh: 你已经被写进通缉令了。
lines.en: You are already on the wanted list.

lines.zh: 王记得每一张不敬的脸。
lines.en: The king remembers every disrespectful face.
A small target; enough to warm up.

lines.zh: 我的卫士呢？算了，王自己来。
lines.en: Where are my guards? Fine, I will do it.
You disturbed the king's peace.

lines.zh: 有人没经通报就走过来。
lines.en: Someone approaches without an announcement.
The king's ears have caught footsteps.
That face is new to the king.
Disturbing the king doubles the offense.
The king raises his hand; kneel.
Three points of damage is royal mercy.
This hand once held a scepter.
You stand too straight; the king dislikes it.
The king waits for you to bow.
My bony finger pokes quite painfully.
Do not dodge; the king's reach is long.
This blow is struck for the crown.

lines.zh: 王不需要武器，只手足矣。
lines.en: A king needs no weapon, only his hand.
I count three, and you will fall.
Which part of you looks most treasonous?
The king's gaze is colder than a blade.
Stand still and receive the king's verdict.
When I raise my hand, the court falls silent.

lines.zh: 王迈一步，你就该退一步。
lines.en: The king takes a step; you should take one back.
Don't hug the wall. The king sees you.
The king is in no hurry. You can't get away.
Only the two of us are left in the hall.

lines.zh: 我把权杖换到了另一只手。
lines.en: I shift the scepter to my other hand.
Kneel, and the king saves two steps.
The royal palm lands; you stagger back.
Three points, small, but humiliating enough.
Striking you requires no drawn sword.
The way you bleed is unseemly.
My hand bones meet your cheek.
This slap is my gift to you.
I have not struck anyone in ages.

lines.zh: 你竟然没跪下，真没规矩。
lines.en: You did not kneel. How improper.
Even striking, the king keeps form.
Be grateful the king struck you himself.
My hand is harder than it appears.
This blow goes into the chronicles.
Do not wail; it wearies your king.
Blood on my robe; you will pay.
The king rises from his tomb.
Where is my throne? Who moved it?
This wasteland was once my kingdom.

lines.zh: 谁在王的土地上盖房子？
lines.en: Who builds on the king's land?
I wake, and the crown is still on.

lines.zh: 臣民呢？怎么一个都不剩。
lines.en: Where are my subjects? Not one remains.
The king has returned. Kneel, all of you.

lines.zh: 这具身体，死时还穿着王袍。
lines.en: This body died still wearing royal robes.
I lay underground far too long.
As of today, this land is mine.

lines.zh: 我的陵墓塌了，只好出来。
lines.en: My tomb collapsed, so I came out.

lines.zh: 新臣民？你看起来勉强合格。
lines.en: A new subject? You barely qualify.

lines.zh: 王冠上的宝石还在发亮。
lines.en: The jewel in my crown still shines.
Hear this: the kingdom is restored.

lines.zh: 王从石棺里撑起一条腿。
lines.en: The king lifts one leg out of the stone coffin.
Dust settles back onto the king's shoulders.
By decree, these ruins are now the capital.

lines.zh: 先把王冠扶正，再谈国事。
lines.en: First straighten the crown, then discuss the realm.
I crush an old inscription underfoot.

lines.zh: 长久无人行礼，王很不惯。
lines.en: No one has bowed in ages. The king dislikes it.
Who dares burn the royal robe?
The king tumbled down his own stairs.
Water fills my crown and drags me down.
The blast scattered the royal procession.
An arrow struck my royal shoulder piece.
Dark magic? Your king has seen plenty.
The king is hungry, but says nothing.
Lightning dares strike a king?

lines.zh: 虚空？王的领土没这一块。
lines.en: The void? Not part of my domain.
